title: Make the drafter probabilistic and the target verify by rejection sampling for simple draft and MTP

target.summary: When a draft is truncated to `dp.n_max`, `dp.result_q` is resized unconditionally even if the drafter never populated it. For drafters that do not produce candidate distributions (such as n-gram drafters), this turns an empty vector into a list of empty candidate sets at temperature > 0, causing the server verifier to attempt rejection sampling with zero probabilities and reject all truncated draft tokens.
notes: faulty statement: resizes result_q even when empty, populating it with empty candidate sets
verifier relies on slot.spec_draft_q being empty when candidates were not drafted to bypass rejection sampling
passes slot.spec_draft_q to drafters that may not populate or reset it
